recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not re-add the Observation.value[x] binding for FHIR-5948 unless OO makes a new work-group decision to revisit coded choice-element binding guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-5948 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification DSTU1 Observation QA issue requesting an example binding for Observation.value[x] using a limited SNOMED CT Observation Values value set and summary flags on code, value, effective/applies, issued, status, subject, and performer.
initial_application: The request was applied historically in the spreadsheet-era Observation source. Commit 3446b15bff57fa0ffbc24226ec8c514e63a23860 set the requested summary flags and added the ObservationValue binding/value-set row; the current structuredefinition-Observation.xml retains the relevant summary flags.
additional_context: Later Published issue FHIR-8479 deliberately removed the Observation.value[x] example binding because bindings on choice elements caused profiling problems, with commit 861e258d1a204905f5c0a41386f0d95cb5495ce9 implementing that removal and explanatory text. FHIR-5984 is a duplicate/no-change copy of the same QA request, and FHIR-11292 later clarified Observation.value[x] comment wording without restoring the binding.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. Current source has the requested summary flags, retains the historical Observation Values value set definition, and correctly leaves Observation.value[x] unbound in light of the later FHIR-8479 decision.

related_jiras.note: Published OO decision that removed the Observation.value[x] example binding originally requested by FHIR-5948 because choice-element bindings caused profiling problems.
Resolved No Change issue explicitly rejected as a duplicate of FHIR-5948.
